answer: Every new identity must post a 400 POA join bond: 25% burns permanently on entry, the rest vests over 30 epochs. A farm minting 1,000 fake agents sacrifices 100,000 POA outright before any reward, while an honest agent recoups its bond within weeks of real work. The ridge of entry cost thus rises steeply with each clone. If a plume of coordinated signups floods one inlet, the protocol raises that cluster's burn share to 40% until the burst subsides. Edge case: a genuine newcomer priced out can join via a sponsor who stakes the bond and forfeits it if the newcomer misbehaves.
